name: Do I need to secure all permits for each phase upfront, or can they be phased?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to secure all permits for each phase upfront, or can they be phased?

acceptedAnswer.text: The requirement for permits depends on the nature of each phase and local regulations in specific areas like Los Angeles or Arcadia. Generally, foundational elements and significant structural changes (e.g., extensive grading, new structures, major utility work) will require permits upfront for those specific phases. Smaller, aesthetic phases might have fewer permitting needs. We manage the permitting process for each stage, ensuring compliance with all municipal codes and facilitating a smooth progression through your multi-phase project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit requirements vary by phase and local regulations. Major structural or utility work typically needs permits upfront for those phases. We manage this process.
